title: Standing Determination on Mill-Owned Bin Rent and Cleanout Charges
content:
Rent on a mill-owned bin is charged monthly, and cleaning a bin between rations is charged as a single charge, at the figures standing against each of the Feed and Animal Nutrition Programmes.

Monthly rent on a mill-owned bin stands at nothing on the Bagged Feed Cash Account and nothing on the Full Nutrition Partner Program, at thirty-five dollars a month on the Bulk Delivered Feed Account, the Custom Mix Ration Program and the Contracted Ingredient Program, and at forty-five dollars a month on the Medicated Feed VFD Program. The charge for cleaning a bin between rations stands at nothing on the Bagged Feed Cash Account and nothing on the Full Nutrition Partner Program, at one hundred and twenty-five dollars on the Bulk Delivered Feed Account, the Custom Mix Ration Program and the Contracted Ingredient Program, and at one hundred and eighty-five dollars on the Medicated Feed VFD Program.

| Programme | Monthly rent on a mill-owned bin | Charge for cleaning a bin between rations |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Bagged Feed Cash Account | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Bulk Delivered Feed Account | $35.00 | $125.00 |
| Custom Mix Ration Program | $35.00 | $125.00 |
| Contracted Ingredient Program | $35.00 | $125.00 |
| Full Nutrition Partner Program | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Medicated Feed VFD Program | $45.00 | $185.00 |

*Hypothetical.* A bin standing on a Medicated Feed VFD Program for three whole months carries forty-five dollars of rent for each of them, one hundred and thirty-five dollars in all, and the cleanout charge of one hundred and eighty-five dollars is a charge of its own and not part of that rent.
